title: Baka
blurb: "Baka!" — the tsundere's load-bearing word. It means idiot and is almost always used to mean approximately the opposite, which is a linguistic trick anime has been running for decades. It is probably the first Japanese word any anime viewer learns, and it has stayed in the meme vocabulary long after the shows that popularised it faded. Delivered here with the full flustered inflection, it is a soundboard essential for Discord servers, affectionate scolding, and telling a friend they are wrong without doing the work of explaining why.
origin: A stock anime delivery of the Japanese word for idiot.
